from datetime import datetime
import re
from collections import defaultdict
# Login file_system
passwords=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(); fs_pwd=[p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
access_token=apis.file_system.login(username='chelsea-burch@gmail.com', password=fs_pwd)['access_token']
# Determine current year
now=datetime.now(); year=now.year
# List all files
all_entries=apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/bills/', access_token=access_token, recursive=True)
# Filter internet bills for this year
internet_paths=[p for p in all_entries if '/internet/' in p and f'/{year}-' in p]
# Group by month
month_files=defaultdict(list)
for p in internet_paths:
    m=re.search(r'/(\d{4}-\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$', p)
    if m:
        month_files[m.group(1)].append(p)
# Choose preferred format: txt if exists else pdf
preferred={}
for month,paths in month_files.items():
    txt=[x for x in paths if x.endswith('.txt')]
    if txt:
        preferred[month]=sorted(txt)[0]
    else:
        pdf=[x for x in paths if x.endswith('.pdf')]
        preferred[month]=sorted(pdf)[0]
selected_months=sorted(preferred.keys())
print('year',year)
print('internet months selected',selected_months)
print('selected files:')
for month in selected_months:
    print(month,'->',preferred[month])

# Extract Total Amount for each selected file
amounts={}  # month -> float
for month in selected_months:
    path=preferred[month]
    file_resp=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=path, access_token=access_token)
    content=file_resp.get('content','')
    # regex for Total Amount => $72 or Total Amount => 72
    m=re.search(r'Total\s*Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content)
    if not m:
        # try alternative patterns
        m=re.search(r'Total\s*Amount\s*[:=]\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)', content)
    if not m:
        # print snippet to help debug
        # find lines containing 'Total'
        lines=[ln for ln in content.splitlines() if 'Total' in ln]
        print('FAILED to parse Total Amount for',month,'from',path)
        print('Total-related lines:',lines[:10])
        continue
    val=float(m.group(1))
    amounts[month]=val
    print('parsed',month,'Total Amount',val,'from',path)

print('amounts',amounts)
print('sum',sum(amounts.values()))
